title: Unnecessary treatment visits
hook: Two stated cases: explore the visit denominator behind a reported fraction.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the visit denominator behind a reported fraction affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Added, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the visit denominator behind a reported fraction in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
